title: Elf Bar ElfX Pod Vape Kit
description: For fans of Elf Bar’s all-conquering disposable puff bars, the new Elf Bar ELFX Pod Kit is here to redefine your vaping experience with an easy to use and super-satisfying refillable Elf Bar Elf X pod kit. This stylish pod system comes equipped with a durable 1000mAh battery that supports up to 30W of power , ensuring super-satisfying, all-day vaping. The kit’s brushed metal design not only looks great but also offers a smooth and comfortable grip, making it a fantastic travel companion. Each kit includes two 2ml pods, featuring Elf Bar’s innovative QUAQ Mesh Dual Coil technology for superior flavour. The pods come with fixed coils in two resistances; the 0.6ohm pod provides a looser, more airy RDL vaping experience, while the 0.8ohm pod is ideal for a tighter MTL draw. Both are designed to deliver precise and authentic flavour from your favourite e-liquids. Refilling the pods is a breeze thanks to the top fill system—simply lift the silicone stopper, fill with e-liquid, and you’re ready to go. The magnetic pod connection ensures that the pods are securely attached yet easy to remove or replace. The device is perfect for those new to vaping or long-time vapers looking for a simple, effective system. Featuring a user-friendly auto-draw mechanism, the Elf Bar ELFX activates instantly when you inhale, with no buttons required. Adjust your vape experience with the side-mounted airflow control slider to tailor your draw from tight to loose. Recharge quickly with the included USB-C cable and keep track of battery life with the innovative neon light display. For Elf Bar fans looking to make the move towards more cost-effective refillable vape kits , the stunning Elf Bar ElfX is the device they’ve been waiting for. We recommend pairing this kit with 50/50 , Nic salt or High PG E-Liquid For the ultimate Elf Bar experience, pair the ELFX pod kit with Elf Bar’s ElfLiq range of 50/50 Nic Salt e-liquids, featuring classic Elf Bar flavours. Please note: When filling your pod with e-liquid for the first time, allow the pod to sit for ten minutes before use. This will allow the e-liquid to better saturate the wicking material, a type of cotton, to prevent dry hits and ensure the best flavour and performance from your coil.
